original_implementation.description: Locally authored spherical finite-volume HLL/Heun Euler evolution, independent of the reference eigenvalue/ODE algorithms. Physical geometry and numerical flux identities are checked separately.

reference_implementation.description: Uses actual pinned LANL ExactPack eigenvalue and similarity RHS code through a pre-collapse-only cached coordinate adapter. It is not an independently reimplemented similarity ODE.

inputs_and_acceptance.policy: Inputs, criteria and numerical sources are fixed before primary unit/PDE execution; failures and attempts are retained if any revision is needed. Presentation changes do not loosen scientific criteria.

figures: Only saved, hash-qualified radial states are mapped to a meridional plane. No plotted image is described as a Cartesian 2D calculation.
